<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Diagnosing missing command palette entry**</details></think>

---

Root cause: `package.json` declares `"main": "./out/extension.js"` but the compiled entry point lives at `out/vscode-extension/src/extension.js`, so VS Code can’t load the extension and never registers `offlineFolderRag.openChat`, which is why the command doesn’t appear in the palette.

---

_**User**_

Root cause: package.json declares "main": "./out/extension.js" but the compiled entry point lives at out/vscode-extension/src/extension.js, so VS Code can’t load the extension and never registers offlineFolderRag.openChat, which is why the command doesn’t appear in the palette. fix the root cause of error .

- `package.json` did not declare any activation events, so VS Code never knew when to activate the extension and therefore never registered `offlineFolderRag.openChat`; the palette can’t show a command that has never been registered.  
- Add the activation event that fires when the target command is invoked:
```json
"activationEvents": [
  "onCommand:offlineFolderRag.openChat"
]
```
- After adding that and reloading the extension host (Developer: Reload Window in the extension-development instance), VS Code will activate the extension before the command palette tries to run `offlineFolderRag.openChat`, and the command will appear.
